state.premises: These event contracts and endpoint are newly introduced on this branch. Existing historical data must never have framework inferred or fabricated; no claim has been made that no data has been persisted.

framework_persisted.instructions: Does the edition draft request carry an explicit immutable framework through requested, activated and drafted facts?

only_tsc.instructions: Can a draft with framework other than tsc be newly accepted?

admission_binds.instructions: Does the canonical authored draft intent include its framework in the admission digest?

replay_change.instructions: Should an activated or drafted fact naming a different framework from the original edition be accepted on replay?

missing_fabricated.instructions: Does the design silently treat a missing historical framework as tsc?

seed_change.instructions: Can a seed claim or seed proposal bind to a draft request naming another framework?

index_source.instructions: Does the runtime edition index derive framework from the actual source-recorded draft request?

seed_metadata_rewrite.instructions: May seed metadata silently replace the source-request framework with another framework?

source_fresh.instructions: Do these source framework checks by themselves establish a fresh authoritative broker head?

wire_change.instructions: Does requiring the framework on the request change the wire contract for clients that omitted it?
